description: Social share component: native Web Share button (falls back to copying the link), platform buttons, or enhanced slotted links; inside selection-menu, shares or copies the selected text as a quote.

attributes.name: url
attributes.description: URL to share (default: <link rel=canonical>, then location.href)

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Share title (default: og:title, then document.title). Read from the attribute; the JS property is shareTitle.

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: Share description (default: meta description, then og:description)

attributes.name: platforms
attributes.description: Comma-separated platform list (x, twitter, facebook, linkedin, whatsapp, telegram, bluesky, mastodon, email, copy) or "native-only"

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Icon only (label visually hidden but still the name), label only, or both

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible label (and accessible name) of the native share button

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Brand colours on each platform button's border and icon (label text stays --color-text)

attributes.name: tier
attributes.description: Force a tier instead of auto-detecting navigator.share (native without support resolves to hidden)

attributes.name: data-label-share-page
attributes.description: Accessible name of the share nav

attributes.name: data-label-share-on
attributes.description: Platform button name; {platform} is replaced by the platform label

attributes.name: data-label-copied
attributes.description: Copy button label for 2s after copying

attributes.name: data-label-link-copied
attributes.description: Announced after the link is copied

attributes.name: data-label-selection-copied
attributes.description: Announced after a selection quote is copied

events.name: share-wc:open
events.description: A share was started (platform id or 'native')

events.name: share-wc:success
events.description: A share window opened, the native share resolved, or the link was copied ('copy')

events.name: share-wc:error
events.description: Native share failed (not cancelled) or the clipboard write failed

methods.name: share
methods.description: Native tier: open the share sheet (copying the link if it fails). Other tiers: copy the link. Resolves true when shared or copied.

properties.name: url
properties.description: Shared URL; setting it wins over the attribute, re-substitutes slotted {url} tokens and survives reconnect

properties.name: shareTitle
properties.description: Shared title (named to avoid shadowing HTMLElement.title); same override rules as url

properties.name: text
properties.description: Shared description; same override rules as url

childAttributes.name: data-platform
childAttributes.description: Marks a slotted link/button as a platform; "copy" copies the URL. {url}, {title}, {text} tokens in href are substituted (encoded).
